title: There are Levels to It: Red Teaming Dialogue With Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2508.04451v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Red teaming is essential for securing Large Language Models, yet current automated methods remain limited by templates and single-turn attacks. To simulate the complex, interactive nature of real-world adversarial attacks, we introduce a novel red teaming paradigm designed to maximize expected cumulative harm through strategic interaction. By formalizing red teaming as a Markov Decision Process in a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, we navigate the challenges of sparse rewards and long-horizon planning. Our generative agent learns diverse, multi-turn attacks using a token-level harm reward, consistently uncovering vulnerabilities that bypass baselines. This approach achieves a new state of the art and reframes LLM red teaming as a principled, trajectory-based process.

translated_title: 层级分明：基于分层强化学习的对话红队测试
translated_abstract: 红队测试对于保障大语言模型的安全至关重要，然而当前的自动化方法仍受限于模板和单轮攻击。为了模拟现实世界中对抗性攻击的复杂交互特性，我们引入了一种新颖的红队测试范式，旨在通过策略性交互最大化期望累积危害。通过将红队测试形式化为分层强化学习框架中的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），我们克服了稀疏奖励和长时程规划的挑战。我们的生成式智能体利用词元级别的危害奖励学习多样化、多轮的攻击策略，持续发现绕过基线方法的漏洞。该方法取得了新的最先进成果，并将大语言模型红队测试重新构建为一个基于轨迹的原则性过程。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于分层强化学习的红队测试新范式，将红队测试形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，通过词元级危害奖励训练生成式智能体学习多轮策略性攻击，在发现大语言模型漏洞方面达到新的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that formalizes LLM red teaming as a Markov Decision Process, training a generative agent with token-level harm rewards to learn diverse multi-turn strategic attacks, achieving a new state of the art in uncovering LLM vulnerabilities.
